title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.22565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. Language models can generate such workflows by writing geometry and toolpath code for each part, but this makes numerical execution part of the model's task. We introduce MillBill, an agent that separates machining decisions from their geometric execution and verification. Given a boundary-representation part, stock, and material, a locally hosted, mid-sized open model proposes operations and cutting parameters for indexed three-axis machining. A geometric harness generates toolpaths, simulates material removal, and returns feedback for plan refinement. Setup planning accounts for what the available cutters can physically reach, rather than visibility alone. translated_title: MillBill：一种具有几何反馈的加工智能体
translated_abstract: 将CAD模型转化为加工程序既需要工艺知识，也需要几何精度。语言模型可以通过为每个零件编写几何和刀具路径代码来生成这样的工作流程，但这使得数值执行成为了模型任务的一部分。我们提出了MillBill，一个将加工决策与几何执行和验证相分离的智能体。给定一个边界表示（B-rep）的零件、毛坯和材料，一个本地托管的中等规模开源模型为分度式三轴加工提出加工操作和切削参数。一个几何工具框架负责生成刀具路径、模拟材料去除，并返回反馈以优化加工方案。装夹规划考虑的是可用刀具实际能够物理触及的范围，而不仅仅是可见性。我们通过模拟加工后目标表面积在规定公差内的比例来评估所生成的程序。使用Qwen3.8-27B模型，MillBill的表现超越了前沿……
tldr: MillBill是一个将加工决策与几何执行验证相分离的加工智能体，通过几何工具框架的模拟与反馈机制，使中等规模的开源语言模型也能生成高精度的数控加工程序。
en_tdlr: MillBill is a machining agent that separates machining decisions from geometric execution and verification, using a geometric harness for simulation and feedback to enable mid-sized open language models to generate high-precision CNC machining programs.
